reason: PowerSession v0.1.16 cannot record headlessly on the windows-pwsh runner: its stdout mirror thread calls WriteConsoleW on the runner's redirected (non-console) stdout, which fails with HRESULT 0x80070001 ('Incorrect function') and panics at record.rs:270 (cascading to terminal.rs:263 SendError). Only the asciicast header is written (cast has 0 output events), so no usable GIF is produced. See run logs.
